idea: Monday slot 2 Healthy habits – WASH YOUR HANDS (BATHROOM, Ava in HOME outfit, on the wooden step stool at the white sink): hook 'Oh no! Messy hands!' – Ava holds up both palms covered with red, blue and green crayon scribbles beside her face, big gasp; SOAP: 'Soap, soap! Bubbles, bubbles!' – she rubs foamy hands, bubbles float up; copy-me 'Rub, rub, rub your hands!'; WATER: 'Water, water! Splash, splash, splash!' – she rinses under the tap, hands clean; TOWEL: 'Towel, towel! Pat, pat, dry!' – she pats dry with the fluffy yellow towel; chorus 'Wash, wash, wash your hands!'; question to the viewer 'Before we eat, what do we do? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'Wash our hands! Yay!'; lesson 'Clean hands for me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now CLEAN palms beside her face, bubbles floating, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Wash your hands with soap and water, then dry them with a towel – and wash before we eat.

learning.goal: Wash your hands in 3 steps: soap, water, towel – and before we eat.
learning.shown_how: Messy crayon palms (problem) -> foamy soap bubbles -> rinse under the tap -> pat dry with the yellow towel -> clean palms in the hook framing.

learning.fact_check: Steps in the right order (soap, rub, rinse, dry); one pink soap bar, one yellow towel; water falls down from the tap (f3 regenerated once – first try looked like a fountain).
learning.modeling: Ava washes her own hands safely on the step stool; positive habit, nothing wrong to correct; crayon marks are clean color, not dirt.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, big face, calm bright bathroom, nothing scary.
